id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.ic_name: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG TAP Controller (TI SSYA002C primer)
fields.topology_type: Daisy-chained serial scan path. Each device's TAP is wired TDO_n → TDI_(n+1); TCK and TMS are bussed in parallel to all devices. Optional TRST is bussed in parallel.

supported_topologies.name: Single-device JTAG
supported_topologies.description: One TAP-equipped device on the board; tester directly accesses TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO.

supported_topologies.name: Linear daisy chain
supported_topologies.description: Multiple TAP devices in series; TDO_n → TDI_(n+1); shared TCK + TMS + (optional TRST).

supported_topologies.name: Backplane ring
supported_topologies.description: Boards arranged in a ring on the backplane; one ring connector at one end; chain wraps around (Chapter 7, Figure 7-13).

supported_topologies.name: Backplane star
supported_topologies.description: Boards arranged in parallel chains via a star configuration; non-standard (parallel chains via splitter) — covered in Chapter 7, Figure 7-14.

supported_topologies.name: Backplane with Addressable Scan Ports (ASP)
supported_topologies.description: Each board has an ASP that can include / exclude the board from the active chain; tester selects which boards participate (Chapter 7, Figure 7-15).

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives TCK + TMS + TDI; reads TDO. May be standalone ATE, an embedded JTAG bridge, or a higher-level system.
Each device implements TAP controller + IR + Bypass + BSR; optional Device ID register; optional INTEST/RUNBIST/etc. instructions.
Backplane-level component that selectively connects / disconnects a board from the daisy chain — extension covered in Chapter 7.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge inside the TAP itself). The architecture is a flat daisy chain at the protocol layer; backplane-level scan-architecture (ring / star / ASP) wraps the basic chain to scale to boards-of-boards.

ordering_guarantees.bit_order_within_a_shift: Bits transmitted LSB-first on TDI; receiver reassembles LSB-first.
ordering_guarantees.device_order_within_chain: Determined by physical TDO→TDI wiring; tester software must know the per-device IR/DR width contributions to slice the shifted stream correctly.
ordering_guarantees.fsm_lockstep_across_chain: All devices in the chain see the same TCK + TMS; their FSMs step in lockstep through SelectDRScan / SelectIRScan / Capture / Shift / Update.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — JTAG registers are not memory-mapped; selection is by IR opcode + TAP state.

device_classification.test_controller: Tester / ATE / embedded JTAG bridge — drives the 4-pin TAP from outside.
device_classification.scannable_ic: IEEE 1149.1-compatible IC with full TAP + BSR + IR.
device_classification.non_scannable_ic: IC without a TAP; cluster-tested through surrounding scannable ICs (Chapter 7).
device_classification.addressable_scan_port: Backplane-level component for boards-of-boards scan architectures.
